summary: Organized around the maintenance and operations life of a built asset: plan and record the work (maintenance management, asset strategy), find what is wrong (three diagnostics capabilities plus condition monitoring), quantify how things fail (reliability analysis, failure and hazard analysis), keep people and the environment safe (occupational safety, environmental compliance), and run buildings and networks (building automation, energy management, facility management, electric grid, pipeline and water, telecom plant). The breakdown follows ISO 55000 and the GFMAM/IAM asset management subjects, ISO 14224 and EN 13306 for maintenance, ISO 13374 for condition monitoring, the IEC dependability standards (60812, 61025, 61078, 61165, 61649, 62740) and SAE JA1011 for reliability, SAE J1979/J1939 and ATA chapters for diagnostics, OSHA 1904/1910 and ISO 45001 for safety, BACnet, Brick and Haystack for buildings, and the IEC 61968 interface reference model for utility operations.

capabilities.name: Maintenance work management

onet_categories: Data base user interface and query software
capabilities.notes: Seed 'Maintenance and enterprise asset management (CMMS, EAM, work orders)' split in two: day-to-day work management stays here; long-horizon strategy (criticality, RCM, renewal planning) moved to operate.asset_strategy because it consumes different inputs (failure models, budgets) and is sold separately. Repair-shop orders are kept here as maintenance records; customer appointment booking and invoicing belong to commerce. Spare-parts stockrooms are move.

existing_function_map.note: Only the operating half: building automation products (Metasys, APOGEE, WEBs-N4, Alerton, inteliWEB, direct digital control) map to operate.building_automation; utility supervisory control to operate.grid_operations; controller fault interpretation to operate.fault_isolation. PLC, SCADA, HMI and DCS programming and plant-floor supervision go to produce; dynamic simulation and control design (LabVIEW, Simulink) to simulate; traffic signal software to move.

Operations only: EMS, DMS, outage management, substation automation and wide-area monitoring map to operate.grid_operations; OMICRON Test Universe maps to operate.electrical_testing.relay_testing. Load flow, short circuit, protection coordination and stability (ETAP, PSS/E, PowerWorld, SKM, Elite Software Short, E-Coord, VDROP) and generation planning (HOMER, PVsyst, RETScreen) go to simulate.
